title: 自由曲面光學量測
summary: 以一片口徑 50 mm、對最佳擬合球面偏離 200 µm、最大斜率 20 mrad 的自由曲面反射鏡為案例：先說明無對稱軸的表面為何讓六個剛體自由度與面形誤差糾纏，必須靠基準與定位標記配準；再比較 CGH 零位干涉、傾斜波非零位干涉、接觸與光學探針輪廓儀及次口徑拼接的物理限制，建立含 CGH 寫入誤差、基板、回溯誤差與熱漂移的不確定度預算，最後以兩種獨立方法交叉驗證並把量測圖回饋到確定性修形與實測重最佳化。
summaryEn: Using a 50 mm freeform mirror with 200 µm departure from its best-fit sphere and 20 mrad maximum slope as the case, the course first shows why a surface without a symmetry axis entangles the six rigid-body degrees of freedom with form error and must be registered through datums and fiducials; it then compares the physical limits of CGH null interferometry, tilted-wave non-null interferometry, contact and optical probe profilometry and subaperture stitching, builds an uncertainty budget covering CGH writing error, substrate, retrace error and thermal drift, and closes by cross-validating two independent methods and feeding the map back into deterministic figuring and as-built re-optimisation.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」與「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom" and "Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「自由曲面定義與基準座標」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Freeform definition and datum frame” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由曲面是沒有旋轉對稱軸的光學面，通常以圓錐基面加上 XY 多項式或 Zernike 項描述，用於離軸反射系統、頭戴顯示與光束整形。量測的對象不是「面」本身，而是面相對於設計座標系的誤差：球面或旋轉對稱非球面可以靠對稱性消去部分剛體自由度，自由曲面卻讓平移、傾斜與繞軸轉動（clocking）六個自由度都和面形誤差混在一起。沒有基準面與定位標記，量到的誤差圖只是某個最佳擬合下的殘差，與設計師在系統中需要的誤差並不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A freeform is an optical surface without a rotational symmetry axis, usually described by a conic base plus XY polynomial or Zernike terms, and used in off-axis reflective systems, head-mounted displays and beam shaping. The measurand is not the surface itself but its error relative to the design coordinate frame: spheres and rotationally symmetric aspheres let symmetry eliminate some rigid-body degrees of freedom, whereas a freeform entangles all six, translation, tilt and clocking, with form error. Without datum surfaces and fiducials the measured map is only a residual under some best fit, not the error the designer needs in the system. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Freeform definition and datum frame”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Freeform definition and datum frame”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Freeform definition and datum frame” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。若目標量測不確定度為 5 nm RMS，橫向配準必須優於約 0.2 µm、角度配準優於約 2 µrad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm. For a target uncertainty of 5 nm RMS, lateral registration must be better than about 0.2 µm and angular registration better than about 2 µrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。若目標量測不確定度為 5 nm RMS，橫向配準必須優於約 0.2 µm、角度配準優於約 2 µrad。
knowledge.textEn: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm. For a target uncertainty of 5 nm RMS, lateral registration must be better than about 0.2 µm and angular registration better than about 2 µrad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom", which statement holds?
options: 接觸探針量到的就是表面本身的高度。
量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。
面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差。
optionsEn: A contact probe reads the surface height directly.
Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty.
Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error.

quiz.explanationEn: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「自由曲面定義與基準座標」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Freeform definition and datum frame” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。
knowledge.textEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom"?
options: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。
optionsEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials.
quiz.explanation: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Freeform definition and datum frame” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沒有基準面與定位標記，量到的誤差圖只是某個最佳擬合下的殘差，與設計師在系統中需要的誤差並不相同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without datum surfaces and fiducials the measured map is only a residual under some best fit, not the error the designer needs in the system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。
knowledge.textEn: If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。
非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed.
A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element.
quiz.explanation: 量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CGH line spacing and retrace error” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀只能解析條紋間距大於兩個像素的區域，自由曲面對參考波前的斜率差讓條紋在大部分區域過密，因此有兩條路：零位測試用電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生與設計表面完全匹配的波前，條紋只反映誤差；非零位測試如傾斜波干涉儀用一組傾斜的點光源，使每個局部區域至少有一個光源的條紋可解析，再用已校正的光線追跡模型扣除非共路的回溯誤差。零位測試精度高但 CGH 專用於一個設計；非零位測試通用但依賴儀器模型的完整校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An interferometer resolves only regions where fringe spacing exceeds two pixels, and a freeform's slope difference from the reference wavefront makes fringes too dense almost everywhere, leaving two routes: a null test uses a computer-generated hologram (CGH) that diffracts a wavefront exactly matching the design surface so that fringes show only error, while a non-null test such as the tilted-wave interferometer uses an array of tilted point sources so that every local region has at least one source with resolvable fringes, then removes the non-common-path retrace error with a calibrated ray-trace model of the instrument. Null tests are the most accurate but each CGH serves one design; non-null tests are general but depend on a fully calibrated instrument model. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CGH line spacing and retrace error”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CGH line spacing and retrace error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry
knowledge.text: 干涉儀只能解析條紋間距大於兩個像素的區域，自由曲面對參考波前的斜率差讓條紋在大部分區域過密，因此有兩條路：零位測試用電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生與設計表面完全匹配的波前，條紋只反映誤差；非零位測試如傾斜波干涉儀用一組傾斜的點光源，使每個局部區域至少有一個光源的條紋可解析，再用已校正的光線追跡模型扣除非共路的回溯誤差。零位測試精度高但 CGH 專用於一個設計；非零位測試通用但依賴儀器模型的完整校正。
knowledge.textEn: An interferometer resolves only regions where fringe spacing exceeds two pixels, and a freeform's slope difference from the reference wavefront makes fringes too dense almost everywhere, leaving two routes: a null test uses a computer-generated hologram (CGH) that diffracts a wavefront exactly matching the design surface so that fringes show only error, while a non-null test such as the tilted-wave interferometer uses an array of tilted point sources so that every local region has at least one source with resolvable fringes, then removes the non-common-path retrace error with a calibrated ray-trace model of the instrument. Null tests are the most accurate but each CGH serves one design; non-null tests are general but depend on a fully calibrated instrument model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry" is correct?
options: 非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。
CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。
干涉儀只能解析條紋間距大於兩個像素的區域，自由曲面對參考波前的斜率差讓條紋在大部分區域過密，因此有兩條路：零位測試用電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生與設計表面完全匹配的波前，條紋只反映誤差。
optionsEn: A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element.
A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected.

An interferometer resolves only regions where fringe spacing exceeds two pixels, and a freeform's slope difference from the reference wavefront makes fringes too dense almost everywhere, leaving two routes: a null test uses a computer-generated hologram (CGH) that diffracts a wavefront exactly matching the design surface so that fringes show only error, while a non-null test such as the tilted-wave interferometer uses an array of tilted point sources so that every local region has at least one source with resolvable fringes, then removes the non-common-path retrace error with a calibrated ray-trace model of the instrument.
quiz.explanation: 干涉儀只能解析條紋間距大於兩個像素的區域，自由曲面對參考波前的斜率差讓條紋在大部分區域過密，因此有兩條路：零位測試用電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生與設計表面完全匹配的波前，條紋只反映誤差；非零位測試如傾斜波干涉儀用一組傾斜的點光源，使每個局部區域至少有一個光源的條紋可解析，再用已校正的光線追跡模型扣除非共路的回溯誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An interferometer resolves only regions where fringe spacing exceeds two pixels, and a freeform's slope difference from the reference wavefront makes fringes too dense almost everywhere, leaving two routes: a null test uses a computer-generated hologram (CGH) that diffracts a wavefront exactly matching the design surface so that fringes show only error, while a non-null test such as the tilted-wave interferometer uses an array of tilted point sources so that every local region has at least one source with resolvable fringes, then removes the non-common-path retrace error with a calibrated ray-trace model of the instrument. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CGH line spacing and retrace error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。寫入機的圖樣定位誤差 50 nm 造成相位誤差 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 波，即約 2 nm 波前、1 nm 表面；定位誤差 0.5 µm 則變成 10 nm 表面誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test. A writer placement error of 50 nm gives a phase error of 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 waves, about 2 nm of wavefront or 1 nm of surface; a 0.5 µm placement error would become 10 nm of surface error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the placement-error map of the CGH writer and convert it through the line-spacing map into a phase-error map for the budget; for a non-null instrument, measure a set of known spheres and flats, compare the retrace error predicted by the model with measurement, and recalibrate the model parameters when the residual exceeds budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。寫入機的圖樣定位誤差 50 nm 造成相位誤差 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 波，即約 2 nm 波前、1 nm 表面；定位誤差 0.5 µm 則變成 10 nm 表面誤差。
knowledge.textEn: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test. A writer placement error of 50 nm gives a phase error of 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 waves, about 2 nm of wavefront or 1 nm of surface; a 0.5 µm placement error would become 10 nm of surface error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry", which statement holds?
options: 表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。
子孔徑越多，拼接結果一定越準。
自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。
optionsEn: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test.
More subapertures always make the stitched result more accurate.
A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials.
quiz.explanation: 表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CGH line spacing and retrace error” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the placement-error map of the CGH writer and convert it through the line-spacing map into a phase-error map for the budget; for a non-null instrument, measure a set of known spheres and flats, compare the retrace error predicted by the model with measurement, and recalibrate the model parameters when the residual exceeds budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：傾斜波干涉儀的模型若未納入準直鏡的實際像差，回溯誤差扣除不完整，所有量測結果都帶有同樣的低階系統誤差，不同鏡子看起來有相同的像散圖樣而被誤認為加工問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain the placement-error map of the CGH writer and convert it through the line-spacing map into a phase-error map for the budget; for a non-null instrument, measure a set of known spheres and flats, compare the retrace error predicted by the model with measurement, and recalibrate the model parameters when the residual exceeds budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算。
兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Obtain the placement-error map of the CGH writer and convert it through the line-spacing map into a phase-error map for the budget.
When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate.
quiz.explanation: 取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain the placement-error map of the CGH writer and convert it through the line-spacing map into a phase-error map for the budget; for a non-null instrument, measure a set of known spheres and flats, compare the retrace error predicted by the model with measurement, and recalibrate the model parameters when the residual exceeds budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “CGH line spacing and retrace error” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 傾斜波干涉儀的模型若未納入準直鏡的實際像差，回溯誤差扣除不完整，所有量測結果都帶有同樣的低階系統誤差，不同鏡子看起來有相同的像散圖樣而被誤認為加工問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：零位測試精度高但 CGH 專用於一個設計；非零位測試通用但依賴儀器模型的完整校正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Null tests are the most accurate but each CGH serves one design; non-null tests are general but depend on a fully calibrated instrument model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 傾斜波干涉儀的模型若未納入準直鏡的實際像差，回溯誤差扣除不完整，所有量測結果都帶有同樣的低階系統誤差，不同鏡子看起來有相同的像散圖樣而被誤認為加工問題。
knowledge.textEn: If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。
傾斜波干涉儀的模型若未納入準直鏡的實際像差，回溯誤差扣除不完整，所有量測結果都帶有同樣的低階系統誤差，不同鏡子看起來有相同的像散圖樣而被誤認為加工問題。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected.

If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication.
quiz.explanation: 傾斜波干涉儀的模型若未納入準直鏡的實際像差，回溯誤差扣除不完整，所有量測結果都帶有同樣的低階系統誤差，不同鏡子看起來有相同的像散圖樣而被誤認為加工問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
